1003-5006-6495-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-5006-6495-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Evereth by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1003-5006-6495-8170.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

883-1981-2415-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
883-1981-2415-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1912-4687-6723.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4687-6723.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

339-677-3899-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

586-864-2511-3125-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2511-3125-7396.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2946-4871-5256-6026.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5256-6026.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6148.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Seasoned Dungeoneer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Seasoned Dungeoneer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Seasoned Dungeoneer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

240-5256-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1256-4742-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-4742-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

147-6797-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-6797-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-6797-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

3165-3532-5078-5705.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra and Glaring Fleshraker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Managorger Hydra trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1912-2816-4028.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by paying {1} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

104-2999-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2999-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1062-3484-5437-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3484-5437-5674.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

313-1777-1809.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, adding {B}{B} and then an amount of additional {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Returned Pastcaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

855-1339-2122-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
855-1339-2122-4050.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3057-3484-3487-5870-6320.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}
3057-3484-3487-5870-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Bloodthirster that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Bloodthirster token enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc, Decoction Module and Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Deal combat damage using the Bloodthirster token. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

116-4264-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Altered Ego on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Altered Ego do not have summoning sickness.
116-4264-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Altered Ego.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Altered Ego.
Activate Altered Ego by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Altered Ego ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2921-3908-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2921-3908-5365.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Spark Double's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.
Spark Double's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-3908-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1309-1987-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1309-1987-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

2292-2533-5925--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1308-2933-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

969-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2040-4437.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
2040-4437.description:
Cast Thief of Blood by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Thief of Blood enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing all counters from all permanents and putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each counter removed this way.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Celestial Convergence triggers, causing you to win the game.

63-1558-2963-4231.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve both triggers, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2602-4013-4067.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land, artifact or creature that can tap to produce at least {C}.
2602-4013-4067.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Lord of Change.
Lord of Change enters the battlefield, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent you control.
Active that permanent by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1988-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
1988-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3311-4106-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Snake Umbra attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
3311-4106-4869.description:
Activate Aquamoeba by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

1636-1700-2273-4587.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Sliver.
An additional Sliver with mana value 1 in library.
1636-1700-2273-4587.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Sliver Overlord's first ability by paying {3}, searching your library for a Sliver with mana value 1.
Cast that Sliver by paying {1}.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat, gaining {1} more each time in step 1 and searching for a Sliver costing up to {1} more each time in step 2.
